title: NHTSA oblique (left) stand-in: mdb214 at 89.68 km/h, 15 deg, 35 % overlap into a standing sedan
notes: Closest setup runnable without new Rust for NHTSA tests 9124 and 8790 (engine/docs/crash-reference/camry-oblique-comparison.md). Real: NHTSA research MDB 2010B (2,491 kg, honeycomb face 2,205 mm wide, 605 mm deep) at 89.7-90.5 km/h into a 1,734-1,759 kg Camry turned 15 deg to its path, 35 % overlap on the car's left. Here: mdb214 into the generated sedan (1,448 kg). Geometry: the barrier heads -165 deg (15 deg off straight on); the inboard edge of a 1.676 m face centred on its origin, carried along its travel, passes 35 % of the sedan's width (1.8889 m) in from its left side at the sedan's extent front (z = 0.9644 m); origin 2.5 m back along the travel; first contact computed.
